title: Indexed lookup after appending one value
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $v$ be an element of $R$, let $vs$ be a finite list of elements of $R$, and let $j$ be a natural number. Looking up index $j$ in the list obtained by appending $v$ to $vs$, using $0$ when the index is out of range, yields either the corresponding lookup in $vs$ or $v$.
